sourceInformation.genre: Arcade garden shooter; tactical score attack
sourceInformation.perspective: Fixed front-facing 2D garden theater, rendered with the native overhead coordinate view
sourceInformation.tech: JavaScript, HTML, Canvas 2D; my-3D2dge 0.89.1 at 8ecc2f62353761187bdfe226f327b7ea5d2eb691 with documented actor-bounds and Fill patches; AI Hub protocol 1, pristine client 1.4.0 at 35a1047f2067b2af3de3943f0fe452f39105d869
sourceInformation.artDirection: Original shaded procedural pixel creatures, honeycomb, flowers, greenhouse scenery, hue-shifted materials, native shadows and honey lights
sourceInformation.animation: Native E.Blob spring/squash animation extended with game-owned update/draw rigs for can, worker, express bee, bird, flowers and pageant; native E.anim spray caps
sourceInformation.audio: Original code-synthesized chromatic garden scherzo, effects and Animalese-style gibberish through Web Audio/native engine buses; music defaults to 10%; no audio files
sourceInformation.online: Standalone solo and simultaneous local two-player co-op; AI Hub authoritative shared-world 1–2 player co-op, including server host, snapshots, departures and team finish. No standalone room broker.
sourceInformation.testing: Headless Node simulation and ordinary-input solo/co-op full campaigns; assembled file:// Chromium/WebKit; emulated standard pads and mobile touch; offline audio; official Hub harness including 150ms latency, 50ms jitter, 5% loss, host-leave, server and 1p, plus real two-copy gameplay. Physical hardware, human listening and live catalogue deployment: unknown.
sourceInformation.research: Read Blue Sky Rangers original cartridge manual and developer-alumni history; inspected gameplay reference image; read pinned engine API/FORMATION kit/headless pattern and official Hub protocol/client/example/fixtures. URLs and conclusions in docs/research.md.

testingFeedback: 10 distinct implementation issues were caught and fixed; fixture/assertion mistakes are excluded. Details are in docs/issues.json.
2 critical issues: transformed actors were invisible, and one-tick touch drag intent barely moved the can. Both are fixed and covered.
The ordinary-input full campaigns proved the complete six-garden loop; actual two-copy Hub spray/call/departure tests then found problems that protocol conformance alone missed.
Boot-only checks were least diagnostic: they passed while custom actors were invisible. A focused visual check exposed the missing crop bounds.
engineFeedback: Native pixel primitives, palettes, rig springs, lighting, input bindings and controller-navigable Shell supplied a coherent base without external assets.
Yes. Custom local-coordinate transforms silently escaped the tracked actor crop; phone Fill also clamped the arena scale above its usable fit.
The rendering-independent tactical simulation and one authoritative co-op ledger, including stable reward identities, last-pulse races and harvest-opened shield phases.
Preserving one fixed arena while extending native rigs and keeping pointer/touch/controller ownership consistent across the Shell and Hub lifecycle.

Two small engine patches: transform-aware actor drawing bounds prevent invisible translated/scaled rigs; fractional native Fill preserves the complete arena on small low-density screens. Other additions are game code.
Add an explicit documented local-coordinate actor drawing contract with transformation-aware crop bounds and a small visual regression example.
promptFeedback: The distinctive source mechanics, native art/audio constraints and permission to use headless testing encouraged a complete, original arcade game.
PLAN.md names a different effort/context budget. TASK.md and the actual assigned model metadata were used for the deliverable names and reporting.
Finishing the whole tactical campaign, native device UX and authoritative shared-world co-op together in one portable HTML.
Supply a machine-readable release metadata template and a minimal official Hub test runner alongside the engine handoff.

aiHub.name: Buzz Comb Party
aiHub.description: Defend a garden party with a very small spray can and a very particular hummingbird. Turn bees into tactical honeycomb, manage your parking space and feed red parcels to crack the pageant shields across six gardens.
aiHub.controls: A/D or stick move; Space/Cross/R2 spray; E/Square call Pip; Escape/Options pause; mouse column aim; touch drag and tap combs.
